Have you checked whether sleep estimates and acceleration levels are plausible?

For example, with the visualreport or by looking at the part 2 results.

Outlier do not necessarily indicate bugs in GGIR, it could also be:
  • something is wrong with the device
  • poor protocol compliance aross the recording
  • truly abnormal behaviour (participant had some movement condition, shift work,  extreme endurance sport, etcetera)
